scripts.build:local-data: npm run build:data && npm run validate:data
scripts.refresh:local-data: npm run refresh:data && npm run validate:data
scripts.build:local: npm run validate:data && VITE_R2_JSON_BASE=/quettaboard npm run build && bash ../scripts/refresh-gpu-state.sh
scripts.build:site: npm run test:efficiency && tsc -b && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts && mv dist-site/site.html dist-site/index.html && mkdir -p dist-site/efficiency && cp dist-site/index.html dist-site/efficiency/index.html && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='dist-site/efficiency/index.html'; fs.writeFileSync(p, fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace('<title>Quettaflop AI</title>','<title>Efficiency Index — Quettaflop AI</title>'))" && node scripts/check-site-bundle.mjs dist-site
scripts.build:web: npm run build:site && rm -rf dist-web && cp -r dist-site dist-web && vite build --base=/board/ --outDir=dist-web/board --emptyOutDir && node scripts/check-site-bundle.mjs dist-web
scripts.build:site-single: npm run build:site && node scripts/inline-site-single-file.mjs dist-site
scripts.postbuild:internal: [ -n "$LOCAL_ARTIFACTS_DIR" ] && for f in gpu-state.json coverage-blockers.synthetic_distributional.json coverage-blockers.moe_ep.json; do [ -e "$LOCAL_ARTIFACTS_DIR/$f" ] && ln -sfn "$LOCAL_ARTIFACTS_DIR/$f" "dist/$f"; done; true
